name: ModelVariant777_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant777_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (every period a jittered lightning bolt of up to twelve points grows from a model point towards the opposing slot. Each point is a fading sprite with a sixteen-ray Gouraud fan; once a bolt is complete it strikes, throwing eight animated debris sprites and sixteen sparks from its tip, optionally flashing the screen while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-794 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant794_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH at the same addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
